tasks.title: Define JWT identity and auth contract for cart/order endpoints
tasks.goal: Establish the authenticated identity contract and authorization expectations before implementing cart and order behavior.

tasks.title: Implement authenticated cart retrieval and total calculation
tasks.goal: Add a cart view endpoint that returns current cart data, item-level product information, and a computed total for the authenticated user.

tasks.title: Implement user-order history and authenticated order access
tasks.goal: Expose an authenticated order-history endpoint and enforce that users only see their own orders.

tasks.title: Complete order creation with stock validation, persistence, and cart clearing
tasks.goal: Finalize the purchase flow so it validates the user, cart, and stock, persists order items atomically, and removes only the purchased selections.

tasks.title: Align product stock and downstream integration behavior for purchase flow
tasks.goal: Ensure product availability checks, stock updates, and error semantics support a consistent order-purchase flow.

tasks.title: Standardize validation, error handling, and authorization across services
tasks.goal: Add consistent validation, global exception mapping, and authorization enforcement across the microservice APIs.

tasks.title: Document runtime dependencies and gateway routing contract
tasks.goal: Make gateway route behavior and required external config explicit and testable for local or demo deployments.

tasks.title: Add purchase-flow and business-rule test coverage
tasks.goal: Verify the end-to-end purchase flow, empty-cart rejection, stock issues, and persistence semantics through tests.

verification.name: smoke flow
verification.command: cd product-service && mvn test -DskipTests=false && cd ../order-service && mvn test -DskipTests=false
